trusted_basis.title: G4.6 Canvas Interaction Presentation Architecture v0.1

dependency.anchor_relation: execution start must descend from canonical main anchor and include accepted A result

viewport_fit_policy.degenerate_extent: fit using epsilon extent then clamp to max_zoom
viewport_fit_policy.rotation: preserve current camera rotation and fit projected bounds in camera-aligned view
viewport_fit_policy.dpr: DPR changes physical pixels only; logical viewport/world fit semantics remain unchanged

snap_policy.rotated_geometry: derive projected view-space extrema/center from current transformed visual bounds
snap_policy.hysteresis: retain active target until release threshold is exceeded
snap_policy.canonical_effect: guide/highlight are transient; only final resolved transform may commit through existing TransformSession

frozen_statements: Viewport/camera is per-view transient state; pan/zoom/fit never creates canonical operations or shared RuntimeScene rebuild.
Snap/Guide is transient interaction/presentation and uses existing scene/spatial query seam rather than document-wide scans.
Camera and snap policies are editor configuration, not canonical schema.
